scripts.test: find tests -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.test.ts' -print | LC_ALL=C sort | while IFS= read -r file; do bun "$file" || exit; done
scripts.test:browser: bun run build && env -u NO_COLOR PLAYWRIGHT_SERVER=preview playwright test
scripts.test:image-ai:performance: bun run build && env -u NO_COLOR PLAYWRIGHT_SERVER=preview PLAYWRIGHT_PERFORMANCE=1 playwright test tests/browser/workflow.spec.ts --grep @performance --workers=1
scripts.test:study:browser: VITE_STUDY_PROFILE=study VITE_STUDY_ENDPOINT=/ms-study/v1 VITE_STUDY_DEPLOYMENT=browser-test VITE_STUDY_CLASS_ID=class VITE_STUDY_SESSION_ID=session bun run build && env -u NO_COLOR VITE_STUDY_PROFILE=study PLAYWRIGHT_SERVER=preview playwright test tests/browser/study-telemetry.spec.ts --grep-invert @study-performance && env -u NO_COLOR VITE_STUDY_PROFILE=study PLAYWRIGHT_SERVER=preview playwright test tests/browser/study-telemetry.spec.ts --grep @study-performance --workers=1
